entries.fb299909d74897bd: A single-segment business that integrally provides the development and sale of package software products addressing security measures and strengthening of internal controls, together with related services such as maintenance and implementation support. The core products are “ESS AdminONE,” for privileged ID management, and the “ESS REC” series, for operation audit trail management. Its headquarters is in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and all 124 employees as of March 31, 2026 are engaged in this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,584 million.
